items.title: ARPut Main Website — Development & Maintenance
points: Built and maintain ARPut's primary public website in vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — no frameworks or UI libraries — acting as the front-end owner of the codebase.
Implemented a WYSIWYG blog editor from scratch: a word-processor-style content creator plus a matching viewer for publishing formatted posts.
Built an animated card showcase from scratch, where cards rotate through a queue and expand to full viewport when their turn arrives — pure JS/CSS, no animation libraries.
Hand-implemented the site's accessibility with vanilla CSS and HTML: keyboard navigation, focus states, ARIA roles, and color contrast.

items.title: ARPutMarket — AR E-Commerce Platform
points: Maintain and modernize the ARPutMarket e-commerce platform built with Next.js, redesigning the UI to its current modern look and improving overall UI/UX.
Implement server-side rendering to strengthen SEO and first-load performance, and optimize front-end performance across the platform.

items.title: Internal Admin Dashboard — Built from Scratch
points: Designed and built a full-stack admin dashboard from scratch, covering UI/UX design, JWT authentication, and the Node.js/Express back end, with product management flows (add / edit / remove products, card management, product summary).

Forked and deeply customized the headless Tiptap editor to build a full blog-management module — extended the library's source code with custom Aparat video embedding, YouTube embedding, image embedding, text alignment controls, Persian (RTL) accessibility, and a fully custom editor UI built on top of the headless core.

education.title: M.Sc. — Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence)

points: Deep-learning and computer-vision coursework implemented from scratch in Python / NumPy — CNNs, GANs, autoencoders, RNNs, and classical vision algorithms — completed alongside full-time development work.
